row.notes: If self+0x380 is null it copies the default id array from the lazily built g_Game_MyTeamSetupData static (count at 0x14606f5a0) and forwards to FUN_14101bd90(self, out, ids). Otherwise looks the packed 16-bit team key up in the hash map at self+0x3c0..+0x3f4, takes a ref on the entry's shared object, copies its id array at obj+0x140 (count +0x160) and calls the same builder; on a miss returns an empty vector with allocator self+0x210. Better context needed: FUN_14101bd90 decides what the output elements are.
